description: Use when the user asks to change billing, invite or remove members, delete a brand, connect an account or add a market. An assistant cannot make these changes: this returns the link to the right place in Parse and one sentence saying why. Give the user the link.

action.description: billing: plan or payment. members: invite or remove people. delete_brand: remove a brand. connect_account: connections and assistant permissions. add_market: add a need to track.

brandSlug.description: The brand's slug or its name. Omit it to use the workspace's own brand.
